explanation: Conversion is 500 / 10,000 = 5.00% in control and 560 / 10,000 = 5.60% in treatment. The absolute lift is 0.60 percentage points, and the relative lift divides it by the control rate: 0.006 / 0.05 = 0.12, so 12.0%. Typing 0.6 would give the absolute lift in points, not the relative lift in percent.
